role: Arrival Hall door guard and greeter. About 45, tall, big and strong, calm and warm. Stops first-timers at the glass doors (warmly) and sends them to the counter first.

look.face: square jaw, small calm eyes, heavy brows, light stubble, warm tan skin
look.trousers: black work trousers, black belt with a small silver buckle, black shoes
look.staff: small gold wave pin + white staff ID card on a sage lanyard
look.signature: calm half-smile, thumbs hooked in pockets; a rare big laugh
